description: Ordre d'intervention des casernes par commune - Département du Territoire de Belfort - SDIS 90 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The departmental risk analysis and coverage plan (SDACR) prescribed in Article L. 1424-7 of the General Code of Local Authorities succeeded the "master plan for the training of personnel and the preparation of emergency means" created by Article 7 of the repealed Law 96-369. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Order of intervention of the barracks by municipality - Department of the Territory of Belfort - SDIS 90" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include casernes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
